metrics.definition: Book/Market: book equity / market equity

metrics.definition: Enterprise value multiple: (me + dltt + dlc + pstk + mib - che) / EBITDA (oibdp) TTM

metrics.definition: Issuer aggregate common market equity / parent net income TTM (USD); cap/earnings analog, not diluted EPS P/E

metrics.definition: Price/Cash flow: market equity / operating cash flow TTM

metrics.definition: Dividend payout ratio: common cash dividends TTM / income before extraordinary items TTM

metrics.definition: Operating profit margin after depreciation: oiadp TTM / sales TTM

metrics.definition: Interest TTM / average long-term debt
metrics.name: int_debt

metrics.definition: Interest TTM / average total debt
metrics.name: int_totdebt

metrics.definition: Cash and short-term investments / total liabilities
metrics.name: cash_lt

metrics.definition: Inventory / current assets
metrics.name: invt_act

metrics.definition: Receivables / current assets
metrics.name: rect_act

metrics.definition: Total liabilities / total assets (WFRS debt_at)
metrics.name: debt_at

metrics.definition: Total debt / EBITDA TTM
metrics.name: debt_ebitda

metrics.definition: Short-term debt / total debt

metrics.definition: Current liabilities / total liabilities
metrics.name: curr_debt

metrics.definition: Long-term debt / total liabilities
metrics.name: lt_debt

metrics.definition: Operating income before depreciation TTM / current liabilities
metrics.name: profit_lct

metrics.definition: Operating cash flow TTM / current liabilities
metrics.name: ocf_lct

metrics.definition: Operating cash flow TTM / total debt
metrics.expr: CASE WHEN (dltt_q0 + dlc_q0) <> 0 THEN (oancf_ttm) / (dltt_q0 + dlc_q0) END

metrics.definition: Free cash flow / operating cash flow
metrics.name: fcf_ocf

metrics.definition: Total liabilities / total tangible assets (AT - INTAN)

metrics.definition: Long-term debt / book equity
metrics.name: dltt_be

metrics.definition: Total debt/equity: total liabilities / shareholders' equity (common and preferred)

metrics.name: de_ratio

metrics.definition: Financial debt / total assets
metrics.name: debt_assets

metrics.definition: Total debt/capital: (ap + dlc + dltt) / (ap + dlc + dltt + ceq + pstk)

metrics.name: debt_capital

metrics.definition: After-tax interest coverage: (xint + ib) TTM / xint TTM
metrics.name: intcov

metrics.definition: Interest coverage ratio: EBIT (NI + tax + interest) TTM / xint TTM
metrics.expr: CASE WHEN (xint_ttm) <> 0 THEN (ni_ttm + txt_ttm + xint_ttm) / (xint_ttm) END
metrics.name: intcov_ratio

metrics.definition: Cash and short-term investments / current liabilities
metrics.name: cash_ratio

metrics.definition: Quick ratio (acid test): (current assets - inventories) / current liabilities
metrics.name: quick_ratio

metrics.definition: Current ratio: current assets / current liabilities

metrics.definition: Cash conversion cycle (days): 365 x (inventories / cogs + receivables / sales - payables / cogs), current balances and TTM flows

metrics.definition: Asset turnover: sales TTM / average total assets

metrics.definition: Inventory turnover: cogs TTM / average inventories

metrics.definition: Payables turnover: (cogs TTM + change in inventories over the year) / average accounts payable

metrics.definition: Receivables turnover: sales TTM / average receivables
metrics.name: rect_turn

metrics.definition: Sales TTM / stockholders' equity
metrics.name: sale_equity

metrics.definition: Sales TTM / invested capital
metrics.name: sale_invcap

metrics.definition: Sales TTM / working capital (act - lct)

metrics.name: sale_nwc

metrics.definition: Accruals / average total assets: (ib - oancf) TTM / average at (Sloan sign)
metrics.name: accrual

metrics.definition: R&D expense TTM / sales TTM

metrics.definition: Advertising expense / sales (latest fiscal year)

metrics.definition: Piotroski (2000) F-score: sum of nine indicators on annual data (f_roa ib/at_t-1 > 0; f_cfo oancf/at_t-1 > 0; f_droa change in roa > 0; f_accrual cfo > roa; f_dlever change in dltt / average at < 0; f_dliquid change in current ratio > 0; f_eqoff sstk = 0; f_dmargin change in gross margin > 0; f_dturn change in sale/at_t-1 > 0); NULL unless all nine are defined
metrics.expr: f_roa + f_cfo + f_droa + f_accrual + f_dlever + f_dliquid + f_eqoff + f_dmargin + f_dturn
metrics.name: piotroski_f
metrics.undef: ((fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300) OR hist_days < 700)

metrics.definition: Altman (1968) Z = 1.2 (act - lct)/at + 1.4 re/at + 3.3 oiadp/at + 0.6 me/lt + 1.0 sale/at (latest fiscal year; me of the session)
metrics.expr: CASE WHEN altman_x IS NOT NULL AND lt_a0 <> 0 AND me IS NOT NULL THEN altman_x + 0.6 * me / lt_a0 END
metrics.name: altman_z
metrics.undef: (fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300)

metrics.definition: Ohlson (1980) model 1 O = -1.32 - 0.407 ln(at, USD millions, undeflated) + 6.03 lt/at - 1.43 (act - lct)/at + 0.0757 lct/act - 1.72 [lt > at] - 2.37 ni/at - 1.83 oancf/lt + 0.285 [ni < 0 both years] - 0.521 (ni_t - ni_t-1)/(|ni_t| + |ni_t-1|) (latest fiscal year)
metrics.name: ohlson_o
metrics.undef: ((fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300) OR hist_days < 335)

metrics.definition: Beneish (1999) 8-variable M = -4.84 + 0.920 DSRI + 0.528 GMI + 0.404 AQI + 0.892 SGI + 0.115 DEPI - 0.172 SGAI + 4.679 TATA - 0.327 LVGI (fiscal years t and t-1; TATA = (ib - oancf)/at)
metrics.name: beneish_m
metrics.undef: ((fy0_datadate IS NULL AND date_diff('day', first_datadate, datadate) < 300) OR hist_days < 335)
